points.description: States that there are four ways to pass a pointer to a function, and gives the four combinations: nonconstant pointer to constant data, nonconstant pointer to nonconstant data, constant pointer to constant data, constant pointer to nonconstant data.
points.partial_credit: Two or three of the four combinations correctly named, or all four described vaguely or with a minor error: 2 to 3 marks.

points.description: Gives the count of four ways, built from combining pointer constness (constant or nonconstant pointer) with data constness (constant or nonconstant data).

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming all four combinations of constant/nonconstant pointer with constant/nonconstant data, in any wording, and saying there are four. Part marks if only some combinations are given or they are described vaguely. No marks for talking only about pass by value or by reference without the const combinations.
